basic_info.description: The long-time residence of world-renowned sculptor and artist Richard X Zawitz,365 Moncada Way is where classic Spanish elegance and timeless beauty come together. Situated on one of Ingleside Terraces best streets, this home invites you to experience a world where art and nature coexist harmoniously.  With its blend of classic elegance and a thoughtful layout, it's perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. The welcoming foyer leads into a study, a formal living and dining room, and a bright Solarium where many of Zawitz's iconic art pieces  were conceived. The solarium makes a perfect environment for your creative dreams. The main level also includes three bedrooms and a bathroom. Below, the spacious lower level offers a versatile room ideal as a family room or private owner's retreat. Sitting on nearly 7,000 square foot lot, there's plenty of room to spread out.  One of the great assets of 365 Moncada Way  lies in its enchanting backyard. A standout feature is the stunning  125 year old Elm tree that stands regally over the garden . There is a serene water fall with colorful koi fish pond, an artist's studio, art displays, and vibrant flowers create an oasis that feels a world away! 365 Moncada is a genuine standout Gem!
